title: Sedan crashes into the rear of a semi-truck on Las Minas Road
excerpt: A white sedan collided with the rear of a large semi-truck Wednesday afternoon on Las Minas Road at the Indian Sunset subdivision in Laredo. Police were on scene; it was not immediately known if anyone was injured.
content:
A strong crash was reported Wednesday afternoon on Las Minas Road at the Indian Sunset subdivision in Laredo.

Video from the scene shows a white sedan that collided with the rear of a large semi-truck. Another vehicle ahead of the truck also appears to have been affected.

A Laredo Police Department SUV was on the scene, and an officer was seen documenting the crash.

It was not immediately known whether anyone was injured. No official statement about the crash had been released as of Wednesday evening.

Source: CristyG News, Facebook, Nov. 18, 2026.
